coverage: Eight municipalities, 90 zone polygons and 781 district polygons in the retained OCHA GeoJSON source (the catalogue summary describes 87 zones and 718 districts), created November 2015 and reviewed April 2024. The source-only 99 entry consists of three artificial offshore circles without district coverage and is excluded from administrative zones and land. The QND95 numerical coordinates in the CRS84-labelled export are transformed to WGS84 using EPSG:1840. Multipart features are dissolved by P-code. Municipality census figures are dated 2020; no population is inferred for zones or districts. Shared country frontiers follow established atlas neighbours; inland lake surfaces are excluded. National statistics are retained while country overview pages remain hidden.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
